candidate.title: ChIPmentation
candidate.scope: Single ChIPmentation workflow in the assigned Illumina schematic, titled “Chromatin immunoprecipitation with sequencing library preparation by Tn5 transposase (ChIPmentation)”. The depicted route begins at chromatin, proceeds through antibody/bead capture and Tn5 adapter insertion, and ends in purified, amplified DNA. The title illustration at far left is contextual, not an extra preparation step. The pale neighboring nucleosome at adapter insertion has no separately captioned route or retained output; no fork or alternative workflow is drawn. The catalogue page heading and caption confirm this target. ATAC-seq, purified-DNA ChIP-tagmentation and standard ChIP-seq are discussed in sources but are not targets of this schematic. The extraction describes this on-bead library-preparation architecture rather than all possible ChIPmentation implementations or an execution recipe.

operations.label: Chromatin immunoprecipitation
operations.description: Captures an antibody-enriched subset of input chromatin on beads, producing bead-associated immunoprecipitated chromatin that remains the substrate for adapter insertion.
operations.mechanism: Antibody recognition and bead capture retain chromatin associated with the chosen protein or histone mark; the pink Y and grey support depict the capture interface.
operations.information_effect: Transfers selection for the antibody target to its associated genomic DNA. This enrichment is the basis for interpreting later DNA reads as a chromatin-protein or histone-mark profile; antibody-dependent selection is not proof of exclusive biological specificity.

operations.label: Adapter insertion
operations.description: Adds the depicted Tn5 transposome reagent to captured chromatin. Tn5 fragments the chromatin DNA and introduces adapter sequences, giving the “Fragmented and primed” DNA product while the reaction is performed on bead-bound chromatin.
operations.mechanism: Tn5-mediated tagmentation couples DNA fragmentation with adapter tagging. The transposome is the catalyst carrying adapter material, rather than an additional biological sample or independent assay.
operations.information_effect: Adds sequencing-library priming interfaces to antibody-enriched genomic DNA. Genomic DNA inserts retain locus identity and the preparation history of antibody enrichment; insertion patterns are also influenced by Tn5 sequence preference, so fine-scale insertions are not automatically direct protein footprints.
